name: v0.0.9
body:
## What's Changed
* feat: tencent docs by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/183
* fix: sre agents by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/178
* feat(mcp): expose Tencent tools over MCP by @rephapeng in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/182
* feat(sentry): full Sentry.io integration by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/184
* feat(linear): first-class Linear integration (PR 1/4) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/185
* feat(notion): CLI integration — REST client, ask agent, MCP tools by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/186
* fix(hermes): runner concurrency + bridge restart in talk by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/187
* fix(security): tighten conversation-history file perms to 0600 by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/188
* fix(security): allowlist-sanitize history-file identifiers via SafeSlug by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/189
* fix/clanker sre deployment by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/190
* feat: new logo by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/191
* feat: optimize inference feedback by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/192
* feat: add Terraform adoption analysis by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/193
* feat: expand cloud provider coverage by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/196
* Add Clanker Cloud LLM provider by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/200
* Fix Clanker Cloud LLM auth header by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/201
* feat: add onboarding CLI dependency setup by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/199
* Improve Clanker Cloud agent MCP flows by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/202
* feat: add observability agent by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/203
* feat: add Clanker Box runtime by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/205
* Stream Clanker Cloud LLM responses by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/206
* Add model override for k8s ask by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/210
* Expose Kubernetes cluster chat over MCP by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/211
* Unified multi-provider logs command (query/tail/chat) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/212
* Improve security scan coverage by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/215
* Fix: k8s logs across all namespaces + tolerate not-ready pods by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/216
* Improve deep research system analysis by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/213
* Logs: count-based 'last N' tail mode (--tail) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/217
* Logs: add GCP, Azure, Cloudflare, DigitalOcean collectors by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/218
* Fix GCP logs (live-verified): env resolution, sources parsing, message fallback by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/219
* Harden GCP/Azure/Cloudflare/DigitalOcean log collectors (review fixes) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/220
* Annotate SRE heartbeats for Cerebro by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/214
* Logs poll/dedup edge-case fixes (review round) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/221
* feat: add live SRE check by @bgdnvk in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/222
* logs: make process-group handling cross-platform (fix Windows build) by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/223
* fix(aws): don't panic on missing optional cluster_name in ECS log tools by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/237
* fix(k8s): data race + premature output read in runCommandStreaming by @rafeegnash in https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/pull/238


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bgdnvk/clanker/compare/v0.0.8...v0.0.9
